ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Electron Application CommandLine
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious CommandLine of electron apps (teams, discord, slack, etc.). This could be a sign of abuse to proxy execution through a signed binary.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\code\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\discord\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\GitHubDesktop\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\keybase\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\_proxy\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedgewebview2\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msteams\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\slack\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Teams\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "chrome\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "code\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "discord\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "GitHubDesktop\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "keybase\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "msedge\_proxy\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "msedge\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "msedgewebview2\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "msteams\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "slack\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "Teams\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-browser\\-subprocess\\-path.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-gpu\\-launcher.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-renderer\\-cmd\\-prefix.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-utility\\-cmd\\-prefix.*")))
